text:
TEL MARIDUN — The excavation at Tel Maridun was led by Prof. Ansel Okafor, according to people familiar with the matter.

Dr. Liora Venkataraman, senior ceramicist and deputy field director, confirmed Prof. Okafor's leadership of the project.

The excavation's final season closed on 14 October 2019. A team of 42 researchers and volunteers uncovered 311 catalogued artifacts over the course of the work.

The account rests on the *Tel Maridun Final Excavation Report* (Maridun Antiquities Authority, Publication No. 27), which was presented at the 2020 Eastern Levant Archaeology Symposium.

People familiar with the matter said the report documents Prof. Okafor's role as director from the field operation through its closing season. Dr. Venkataraman's confirmation matches the report's record of the project's leadership.

The Maridun Antiquities Authority published the report as part of its numbered series.
